temporaryPassword.description: Temporary password assigned at account creation

code.description: Stable application error code when the client needs to distinguish conflict types.

fieldErrors.description: Validation errors keyed by request field; values are human-readable strings.

AppointmentAvailabilityResponse.description: Aggregated appointment availability response for a given date

professionalId.description: Dentist ID if specific filter was requested, null for aggregate clinic availability

slots.description: Available time slots on the requested date

AppointmentContactAttemptResponse.description: Details of a contact attempt made by staff

assignedProfessional.description: Reception assignment; null when no dentist has been assigned

contact.description: Non-clinical contact details for public submissions

source.description: Administrative source classification: PUBLIC or PATIENT_PORTAL

AppointmentSlotResponse.description: Representation of an appointment time slot with its availability status

availableCapacity.description: Number of open capacity spots currently available

slotTime.description: Instant in UTC when the slot starts

status.description: Availability status for this slot: AVAILABLE, REQUESTED, BOOKED, UNAVAILABLE

totalCapacity.description: Total theoretical capacity for this slot

newPassword.description: Permanent password to set for the account

CreateContactAttemptRequest.description: Reception contact attempt record for an appointment request

notes.description: Notes regarding the call or conversation
notes.example: El paciente confirmó disponibilidad para el martes por la tarde.

CreateOdontogramFindingRequest.description: Request payload to record an odontogram finding on a tooth or tooth surface

attentionId.description: Optional clinical attention ID to link this finding with an ongoing encounter

surface.description: Anatomical surface of the tooth (null for whole-tooth findings)

CreatePublicAppointmentRequest.description: Non-clinical administrative information needed to request a first appointment

alternativeId.description: Alternative ID or passport for foreigners

cui.description: Optional Guatemalan DPI/CUI for identity reference (verified in person)

guardianName.description: Legal guardian full name if patient is a minor

guardianRelationship.description: Relationship with guardian (e.g. Madre, Padre, Tutor)

professionalId.description: Optional preferred active dentist; omit or send null if there is no preference

reason.description: Optional non-clinical scheduling context only. Do not include symptoms or medical details.

requestedAt.description: Preferred future time in ISO-8601 UTC. This is a request, not a reservation.

MobileLoginResponse.description: Mobile authentication response containing tokens and user view

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token for mobile secure storage
Opaque refresh token previously issued to the mobile device

MobileRefreshResponse.description: Mobile session refresh response containing rotated tokens

refreshToken.description: New rotated opaque refresh token for mobile secure storage

attentionId.description: Clinical attention ID if registered during an encounter

OdontogramResponse.description: Patient odontogram chart representation with tooth and surface findings

recentFindings.description: Chronological list of recent findings for this dentition

teeth.description: Detailed list of teeth and their surface-level findings

teethSummary.description: Summary map of toothCode to primary finding for backward compatibility

PublicAppointmentRequestReceipt.description: Safe acknowledgment for an anonymous appointment request

PublicAppointmentRequesterResponse.description: Contact details supplied for a public request; visible only to authorized clinic staff

PublicAssistantRequest.description: Message sent to the public virtual assistant

aiProcessingAccepted.description: Mandatory user consent for AI message processing

availabilityDate.description: Optional specific date for checking appointment availability (YYYY-MM-DD)

message.example: ¿Qué horarios tienen disponibles para primera cita?

PublicAssistantResponse.description: Response returned by the public virtual assistant

action.description: Recommended UI action: GUIDE_TO_INTAKE, PROVIDE_INFORMATION, NONE

reply.example: Contamos con disponibilidad el día solicitado. Por favor selecciona tu horario preferido.

suggestedSlots.description: Suggested available appointment slots, if availability was consulted

ToothStateResponse.description: Represents the derived clinical state and surface findings of a specific tooth

globalFinding.description: Whole-tooth finding if applicable (e.g. MISSING, IMPLANT, CROWN)

lastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp when this tooth was last updated by a finding

surfaces.description: Map of anatomical surfaces to their current finding
